sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The league leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before drawing their last match, and face an Alsager side languishing at the bottom with just 4 points from 10 games and on a run of five losses in their last six.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could have title-race implications if Sandbach slip up. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table despite a recent loss, host struggling Eccleshall, who have won their last two but lost three of their last five overall. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter; both are in single figures for losses this season. Bilston Town, sixth and in-form with two wins in their last three, visit Foley Meir, who have picked up a win in their latest outing. In tighter contests, Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter are in freefall with five consecutive defeats—while New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town, with both sides struggling in the lower half. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement-area clash between two of the division's weakest performers, and Crewe, also struggling near the foot of the table, host Allscott Heath in another fixture between sides with limited recent success.
